messages:
sana: Quick heads-up: Greenhouse webhook had a partial outage overnight. A bunch of interviews were created without scorecards attached. Can we triage?

mike: saw it. webhook retried but some payloads were dropped (429->timeout). I can run a targeted backfill to set scorecard_id for affected interviews.

alexa: how many are we talking about roughly?

mike: ~35-50 depending on dedupe. I'll run a dry-run first.

alexa: please don't change anything until we confirm template mapping. Last time a backfill overwrote a custom panel for two roles.

jordan: this was the loop-recruiter flow where scorecard mapping is applied at creation. outage skipped the mapping step. Template name: "Panel - Technical v2".

mike: plan: dry run -> post CSV sample to thread -> apply. Backfill only writes scorecard_id when empty, idempotent. Example command:

```
# dry run
python tools/ats_backfill.py --from 2025-11-01 --to 2025-11-02 --dry-run --filter webhook_outage

# apply
python tools/ats_backfill.py --from 2025-11-01 --to 2025-11-02 --apply --notify
```

sana: ok approved. alexa, can you spot-check role mappings for SRE/Platform before mike applies?

alexa: on it. will check templates and post a quick mapping table here.

recruiting-bot: Backfill job queued (job_id=88211). ETA ~90s.

mike: dry run finished: 43 interviews would be updated. sample rows: Candidate 8012 interview 1198 -> add panel-tech-v2. No conflicts detected.

alexa: mapping check done: SRE/Platform uses "Panel - Platform" for senior roles, but the recruiter loop should have assigned panel-tech-v2 for initial screen. None of the 43 match senior-platform. safe to apply.

mike: applying now. will post log.

recruiting-bot: Backfill job completed. job_id=88211. 43 rows updated. Summary: 43 scorecards attached, 0 skipped. See logs: https://internal-logs/redwood/backfill/88211

mike: log snippet:
```
2025-11-05T09:12:18Z INFO updated interview 1198 scorecard_id=panel-tech-v2
2025-11-05T09:12:19Z INFO updated interview 1203 scorecard_id=panel-tech-v2
```

jordan: spot-checked 5 random interviews, scorecard fields present and scoring sections correct.

sana: great. follow-ups: 1) alexa please schedule a 20-30m rubric refresh for interviewers to cover the new scorecard fields; 2) mike add a Slack alert to the backfill workflow that pings #people-ops when >10 updates occur in a single run.

mike: will add alert to workflow and include CSV of updated interview ids.

alexa: proposing Thu 11am for the rubric refresh. I'll send invite to eng interviewers + post the checklist doc in #people-ops.

sana: thanks all. closing thread once calendar invite is sent and alert is added. :white_check_mark:
